"如黑夜浪潮裡懸空的高腳屋，凝滯於潮汐間的蒼鷺，漁船與靈蝦，還有星空下的藍色眼淚，電影銜接「社會之外」的人群：被視為精神病患、家中累贅的雪虹，與坐牢出獄、頂著「犯罪者」標籤的阿忠。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "倘若深密的黑潮能夠滋養生命，那麼故鄉便是生命的根源，母親的子宮。於是，談及《黑潮》之前，我們得先論及故鄉。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/VmgfiqQfidzJYQuZ1k14lrOAVJCSxOw3MI_L9gU8FuI/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/abc7cf40-7c51-4063-b61a-626d0b014a33.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "旅居臺北二十餘年的馬華作家馬尼尼為，於寫作十年之際，選擇轉身凝視故鄉馬來西亞。她以《故鄉無用》（2024），寫就故鄉裡已然成形的無用，透過不帶罪惡感的狡黠筆尖，摩挲活在「社會之外」無用的東西，一邊寫作卻也一邊感受，自己在無用的他人眼中，如何成為澈底的無用。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "「麥木娜，噢麥木娜，噢魯嗨呦，非常美麗的麥木娜／你的樣子那麼美，你的眼睛那麼圓／那麼美的眼睛，那麼美的臉／要睡就睡，要睡就睡／別被遠方人惦記，別被遠方人惦記」 麥木娜是村裡最有名的瘋子，唱著唱著便成了瘋子的代名詞。詩歌也似的文字彷若招魂咒語。詭鄉是鬼鄉，鬼鄉亦是歸鄉。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "離開故鄉許久，馬尼尼為拾掇鄉愁，歸返之間再憶故鄉。既是重新憶起也是重新記憶，我們指認的故鄉，究竟於何時成形（心理上而非地理上）？我們是在哪一瞬間「意識」，並且毅然說出：我來自何方。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "那處「何方」，有時生發於離散之後。 好似身在故鄉，反而無感無知於故鄉；無感無知未必由於感知力薄弱，而是所感所知全憑環境給予，便視一切理所應當。然而，在離散的路途之間，經由他者身上的異同，於是感知自身的「不同」，鏡像般地映射著故鄉始終淌於身體裡、黏在皮膚上的殘渣。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/C-BJkkbKkuxCj0oGTtJqacCq24NEQJbWMlHwJChUlfk/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/7d1ec1cb-dcb9-4a14-84cb-7c619cd4ed22.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/ycobGWqzX_4sNWarz6tvRwATQAjsk2mKYU0tkUSQmoE/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/7d970a47-8500-459b-8a5f-f86b7c937a3b.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》之於池家慶，便是自打撈的碎屑裡重新拼湊故鄉，從而望見習以為常裡的「異常」，再由「異常」劍指冷漠社會的習以為常。其故事，源起於幾年前因病逝世的故友。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他總是想起朋友的笑容，笑容背面是不曾被善待的傷。電影裡的雪虹，池家慶記憶中的麥木娜， 「我還住在漁村的時候，其實當時的感受沒有那麼強烈，是在我搬離漁村之後，才接著完成這個故事。回頭去看曾經生活的故鄉，我覺得有一種封閉感。」"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "漁村是池家慶長久以來的創作佈景，自 2011 年電視電影《媒人幫》（The Superb Matchmakers）的「百年華人漁村」巴西不南邦（Pasir Penambang），再到取景於臺灣宜蘭沿間的首部劇情長片《嗨！神獸》（Hello! Tapir，2020），同樣起自記憶中的漁村景緻。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "作為馬來西亞土生土長的電影工作者，池家慶再次回到成年以前的居所。《黑潮》的漁村場景同為巴西不南邦，童年時光的風景，更早以前是中國福建一代的華人，離鄉背景下南洋，輾轉行經馬來西亞雪蘭莪州（Selangor），最終落腳西部沿海地區，成為此地的第一代移民。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "聚落由芭頭、芭中、芭尾、椰腳與港口組成，眾人皆為討海的人。「芭」字在福建話有叢林之意，頭、中、尾標示著先輩開墾的路徑，「椰腳」則因早前佈滿椰樹而得名，是漁村的主要經濟作物，而村民為方便出海捕魚，因應潮汐之變遂沿雪蘭莪河畔搭建成排的高腳屋。《黑潮》開場，雪虹困囿其中的四方場景。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/q82CooM97WiNaRYAOeq59XXUj7LaMpWUqA_aobH8BPg/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/f1f6d523-a7c6-445d-9c68-9185cde1bb93.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/Iayd9ykdhkf2rjkk9aamg-WnHIgbjH6FiCc_I5XnoUg/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/a987df78-c300-40f6-9df6-a34ea94b2f64.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "討海人靠天吃飯，可經常敵不過老天的安排。即使掛上「百年華人漁村」招牌轉型做觀光，活在底層的人群卻依舊邊緣徘徊。 富者愈富，貧者愈貧，在電影中的「拿督」用錢就能買到，那是屬於富者的榮耀──政府以封號表揚對國家有所貢獻之人，奈何有貢獻者皆是富者。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "「拿督」對出獄後依舊向海討生的阿忠說：「以後都要蓋旅館了，靈蝦都跑掉了。」種族政策不僅加深族群隔閡，亦潛移默化地鞏固著階級秩序，如欲擺脫階級，討海的人便不得不嘗試走出去。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "巴西不南邦離城市不算太遠，距池家慶遠走的巴生市（Klang），車程約一小時左右。可這一個小時的車程，卻已劃出極大的差異。池家慶是出走之人，雪虹和阿忠卻沒能成為逃海之人。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "雪虹被送往的精神病院，實為所謂的「非法殘障中心」，不具備專業的醫療設備、照護環境，而在撰寫劇本、田野調查期間，池家慶也實際參訪城鎮、鄉村的非法殘障中心，實際環境遠比電影所呈現的還要惡劣。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "部分私營精神病院的收費昂貴，一般家庭無力負擔；政府公營的精神病院多設立於大型城市，醫療能量有限經常需預約排隊，僧多粥少使得病情稍微轉好的患者需釋出床位，讓醫院收納病況較差的患者，可患者離院後仍會因缺乏引導、照護，不僅難以與社會接軌，也經常因為大眾對疾病的陌生，故經歷反覆、甚至惡化的病程。在公營病院的幾次往復後，部分親屬便會選擇將之困鎖家中，或求助民間信仰，或送入非法殘障中心。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/Kj9DjWq7nBW7dZnlcaTvXcF16Vx3Y-DYSX6qNIjn3oc/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/4c6b0d14-0146-4827-b9eb-eb583e9ef134.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue"}, {"type": "quote", "text": "「我們的醫療量能還不足以接收所有的精神病患，社會也不懂得如何銜接他們這樣的狀態，很多都是被送進非法殘障中心後，家人就消失了。講不好聽一點，其實就像是一群在等死的人。但電影也不是為了要論斷對錯，只是希望大家可以重新思考，這樣對他們真的好嗎？這些以保護為名的舉動，未必是在保護他們，這是我覺得比較殘酷的現實。」"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "雪虹被哥哥囚禁在房間，地板上的一方「窗口」開向潮汐間，實際功能為傳統高腳屋的便溺之口。可這只「窗口」卻也是她和阿忠相遇，與世界連結的「出口」。池家慶以此隱喻： 即使能走出去，她又能去哪裡？何以為「家」？"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "中國導演 王兵 以紀錄片《瘋愛》（Til Madness Do Us Part，2013），將鏡頭探入雲南昭通市精神康復醫院的精神病患。近四個小時的片長，前三個小時記錄病院裡形形色色的人，因著各種原因來到這裡的病者，在「異常」之外也如常人那般交心取暖。有人死去，有人受政府遺棄，有人遭親屬拒之門外。", "links": [{"text": "王兵", "url": "https://filmaholic.tw/t/%E7%8E%8B%E5%85%B5/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "電影最後二十分鐘，鏡頭跟著一位病情轉好的患者離開醫院，一路走著走著，卻不知要走到哪，於是走回破敗的家，與老邁的父親無言對坐，待了一會又再走出去。他就這麼一直走著，走到湖邊，鏡頭便停在那裡。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/YP4z5Yc-FsgVqPMumvCw0MJ7MjuCUIplfFb04FLdjmA/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/a2ff5145-7e5c-4840-87b9-f68e32adfbec.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue", "caption": "", "credit": "釀電影"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue"}, {"type": "quote", "text": "「我看到《瘋愛》結尾的時候非常震撼。當他們從精神病院出來，又可以去哪裡？哪裡才是他們的家？哪裡才是他們能感到安全的地方？沒有。」"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "後來，雪虹因遭人侵犯，悲慘之上再砸下又重又狠的一槌，前後情節的鋪展難免營造消費女性苦難之感，可池家慶旨不在事件本身，想讓觀眾看見的是事件之後，周遭人的狀態， 「大家好像都若無其事，繼續過著平平靜靜的生活，那才是最可怕的，無視比殺人還恐怖。」"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "另一面的阿忠，因涉及殺人案件而入監坐牢。出獄後回到故鄉，卻如幽靈般遊走於世界之外，終日背負罪惡感，又拋不開原生家庭帶來的傷害。雪虹向他唱起搖籃曲〈天黑黑〉，撫慰／勾起藏在阿忠心裡，曾遭母親拋棄的記憶。 母親亦以蒼鷺的身影，現身在雪虹的夢裡，那是一隻不願回應她的蒼鷺，早已離世的母親。於池家慶而言，阿忠和雪虹都是迷路的小孩。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://img.vocus.cc/zzkzOBql6jsUwcF8W7KcT3toQA9-9EZ4Bkn6motuXtI/w:740/f:jpg/plain/https://images.vocus.cc/577d004c-4933-4750-a290-154f266ee43e.jpg", "alt": "《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue", "caption": "", {"type": "paragraph", "text": "孩子來到世上遇見的第一個人，是母親，孩子亦經由母親的目光，嘗試認知世界。佛洛伊德（Sigmund Freud，1856－1939）卻又說，人類在本質上無法去愛他人，其旨意在於生命的最終標的，是為滿足自我而前進。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": article_text:
採訪、撰文／蔡若君 專訪攝影／ioauue 劇照、工作照提供／甲上娛樂 責任編輯／黃曦 核稿編輯／黃曦

綜觀近年來自馬來西亞的電影工作者，其創作路徑經常循著歸返的潮水，通過電影流向生命的源頭。如 廖克發 以 《人生海海》（The Waves Will Carry Us，2025） 的虛構影像，重現馬來西亞華人的百年遷徙軌跡； 張吉安 則在 《南巫》（The Story of Southern Islet，2020） 、 《地母》（Mother Bhumi，2025） 等作，經由民間信仰的詭譎幻影，映現故鄉吉打州（Kedah）在大歷史敘事下的荒誕。

同樣是馬來西亞電影，李心潔監製、 王禮霖 執導的 《富都青年》（Abang Adik，2023） ，主演為近十年於國際影壇屢獲佳績的陳澤耀，故事的目光來自吉隆坡的富都老社區，與馬來西亞的真實新聞，且與導演王禮霖的生命經驗隱隱相連；製作於 2025 年，池家慶的第二部劇情長片 《黑潮》（Dead Tide，2026） ，找來王禮霖和李心潔共同監製，電影的目光依然是眾人的故鄉，在那片熟悉的土地上，他們挖掘陌生卻又過分靠近自己的故事，以電影文本、圖像語言，呈示其中不被社會所注目的敘事。

如黑夜浪潮裡懸空的高腳屋，凝滯於潮汐間的蒼鷺，漁船與靈蝦，還有星空下的藍色眼淚，電影銜接「社會之外」的人群：被視為精神病患、家中累贅的雪虹，與坐牢出獄、頂著「犯罪者」標籤的阿忠。

倘若深密的黑潮能夠滋養生命，那麼故鄉便是生命的根源，母親的子宮。於是，談及《黑潮》之前，我們得先論及故鄉。

《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂

旅居臺北二十餘年的馬華作家馬尼尼為，於寫作十年之際，選擇轉身凝視故鄉馬來西亞。她以《故鄉無用》（2024），寫就故鄉裡已然成形的無用，透過不帶罪惡感的狡黠筆尖，摩挲活在「社會之外」無用的東西，一邊寫作卻也一邊感受，自己在無用的他人眼中，如何成為澈底的無用。

「麥木娜，噢麥木娜，噢魯嗨呦，非常美麗的麥木娜／你的樣子那麼美，你的眼睛那麼圓／那麼美的眼睛，那麼美的臉／要睡就睡，要睡就睡／別被遠方人惦記，別被遠方人惦記」 麥木娜是村裡最有名的瘋子，唱著唱著便成了瘋子的代名詞。詩歌也似的文字彷若招魂咒語。詭鄉是鬼鄉，鬼鄉亦是歸鄉。

離開故鄉許久，馬尼尼為拾掇鄉愁，歸返之間再憶故鄉。既是重新憶起也是重新記憶，我們指認的故鄉，究竟於何時成形（心理上而非地理上）？我們是在哪一瞬間「意識」，並且毅然說出：我來自何方。

那處「何方」，有時生發於離散之後。 好似身在故鄉，反而無感無知於故鄉；無感無知未必由於感知力薄弱，而是所感所知全憑環境給予，便視一切理所應當。然而，在離散的路途之間，經由他者身上的異同，於是感知自身的「不同」，鏡像般地映射著故鄉始終淌於身體裡、黏在皮膚上的殘渣。

《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂

《黑潮》工作照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂

《黑潮》之於池家慶，便是自打撈的碎屑裡重新拼湊故鄉，從而望見習以為常裡的「異常」，再由「異常」劍指冷漠社會的習以為常。其故事，源起於幾年前因病逝世的故友。

他總是想起朋友的笑容，笑容背面是不曾被善待的傷。電影裡的雪虹，池家慶記憶中的麥木娜， 「我還住在漁村的時候，其實當時的感受沒有那麼強烈，是在我搬離漁村之後，才接著完成這個故事。回頭去看曾經生活的故鄉，我覺得有一種封閉感。」

漁村是池家慶長久以來的創作佈景，自 2011 年電視電影《媒人幫》（The Superb Matchmakers）的「百年華人漁村」巴西不南邦（Pasir Penambang），再到取景於臺灣宜蘭沿間的首部劇情長片《嗨！神獸》（Hello! Tapir，2020），同樣起自記憶中的漁村景緻。

作為馬來西亞土生土長的電影工作者，池家慶再次回到成年以前的居所。《黑潮》的漁村場景同為巴西不南邦，童年時光的風景，更早以前是中國福建一代的華人，離鄉背景下南洋，輾轉行經馬來西亞雪蘭莪州（Selangor），最終落腳西部沿海地區，成為此地的第一代移民。

聚落由芭頭、芭中、芭尾、椰腳與港口組成，眾人皆為討海的人。「芭」字在福建話有叢林之意，頭、中、尾標示著先輩開墾的路徑，「椰腳」則因早前佈滿椰樹而得名，是漁村的主要經濟作物，而村民為方便出海捕魚，因應潮汐之變遂沿雪蘭莪河畔搭建成排的高腳屋。《黑潮》開場，雪虹困囿其中的四方場景。

《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂

《黑潮》電影劇照／劇照提供：甲上娛樂

討海人靠天吃飯，可經常敵不過老天的安排。即使掛上「百年華人漁村」招牌轉型做觀光，活在底層的人群卻依舊邊緣徘徊。 富者愈富，貧者愈貧，在電影中的「拿督」用錢就能買到，那是屬於富者的榮耀──政府以封號表揚對國家有所貢獻之人，奈何有貢獻者皆是富者。

「拿督」對出獄後依舊向海討生的阿忠說：「以後都要蓋旅館了，靈蝦都跑掉了。」種族政策不僅加深族群隔閡，亦潛移默化地鞏固著階級秩序，如欲擺脫階級，討海的人便不得不嘗試走出去。

巴西不南邦離城市不算太遠，距池家慶遠走的巴生市（Klang），車程約一小時左右。可這一個小時的車程，卻已劃出極大的差異。池家慶是出走之人，雪虹和阿忠卻沒能成為逃海之人。

雪虹被送往的精神病院，實為所謂的「非法殘障中心」，不具備專業的醫療設備、照護環境，而在撰寫劇本、田野調查期間，池家慶也實際參訪城鎮、鄉村的非法殘障中心，實際環境遠比電影所呈現的還要惡劣。

部分私營精神病院的收費昂貴，一般家庭無力負擔；政府公營的精神病院多設立於大型城市，醫療能量有限經常需預約排隊，僧多粥少使得病情稍微轉好的患者需釋出床位，讓醫院收納病況較差的患者，可患者離院後仍會因缺乏引導、照護，不僅難以與社會接軌，也經常因為大眾對疾病的陌生，故經歷反覆、甚至惡化的病程。在公營病院的幾次往復後，部分親屬便會選擇將之困鎖家中，或求助民間信仰，或送入非法殘障中心。

《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

「我們的醫療量能還不足以接收所有的精神病患，社會也不懂得如何銜接他們這樣的狀態，很多都是被送進非法殘障中心後，家人就消失了。講不好聽一點，其實就像是一群在等死的人。但電影也不是為了要論斷對錯，只是希望大家可以重新思考，這樣對他們真的好嗎？這些以保護為名的舉動，未必是在保護他們，這是我覺得比較殘酷的現實。」

雪虹被哥哥囚禁在房間，地板上的一方「窗口」開向潮汐間，實際功能為傳統高腳屋的便溺之口。可這只「窗口」卻也是她和阿忠相遇，與世界連結的「出口」。池家慶以此隱喻： 即使能走出去，她又能去哪裡？何以為「家」？

中國導演 王兵 以紀錄片《瘋愛》（Til Madness Do Us Part，2013），將鏡頭探入雲南昭通市精神康復醫院的精神病患。近四個小時的片長，前三個小時記錄病院裡形形色色的人，因著各種原因來到這裡的病者，在「異常」之外也如常人那般交心取暖。有人死去，有人受政府遺棄，有人遭親屬拒之門外。

電影最後二十分鐘，鏡頭跟著一位病情轉好的患者離開醫院，一路走著走著，卻不知要走到哪，於是走回破敗的家，與老邁的父親無言對坐，待了一會又再走出去。他就這麼一直走著，走到湖邊，鏡頭便停在那裡。

《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

「我看到《瘋愛》結尾的時候非常震撼。當他們從精神病院出來，又可以去哪裡？哪裡才是他們的家？哪裡才是他們能感到安全的地方？沒有。」

後來，雪虹因遭人侵犯，悲慘之上再砸下又重又狠的一槌，前後情節的鋪展難免營造消費女性苦難之感，可池家慶旨不在事件本身，想讓觀眾看見的是事件之後，周遭人的狀態， 「大家好像都若無其事，繼續過著平平靜靜的生活，那才是最可怕的，無視比殺人還恐怖。」

另一面的阿忠，因涉及殺人案件而入監坐牢。出獄後回到故鄉，卻如幽靈般遊走於世界之外，終日背負罪惡感，又拋不開原生家庭帶來的傷害。雪虹向他唱起搖籃曲〈天黑黑〉，撫慰／勾起藏在阿忠心裡，曾遭母親拋棄的記憶。 母親亦以蒼鷺的身影，現身在雪虹的夢裡，那是一隻不願回應她的蒼鷺，早已離世的母親。於池家慶而言，阿忠和雪虹都是迷路的小孩。

《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

在漁村長大的池家慶，聽過許多母親逃離漁村的故事。漁村給他的另一個感受，是女性亟欲掙脫的困境，他在田調時曾與許多精神病患者聊天，他們經常一開口便談起母親：「媽媽什麼時候來？」

孩子來到世上遇見的第一個人，是母親，孩子亦經由母親的目光，嘗試認知世界。佛洛伊德（Sigmund Freud，1856－1939）卻又說，人類在本質上無法去愛他人，其旨意在於生命的最終標的，是為滿足自我而前進。

因此，若將所謂「愛是本能」置換為「理解如何去愛」，那麼母親便是「理解」之前的源泉。電影出現了三個缺失母親的小孩：雪虹、阿忠，以及父親遭殺害後、母親即離開漁村的家豪。 或許因為失去了那份理解之源，孩子便只能在殘酷的世界裡，汲汲營營於「愛」。

池家慶將長自身體裡的感受，自然而然地雜揉進電影裡；同時，在電影前段以畫外音與半雙手的形式，隱晦地揭示雪虹遭遇的（家人和伴侶）男性暴力。 然而，雪虹是如何（被）成為「精神異常」的雪虹？亦即，社會何以形構出所謂的（女性）困境，使得這一群「社會之外」的人──雪虹與阿忠──自黑夜一路墮入永夜？

《黑潮》導演池家慶專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

池家慶將提問帶回故事本身。其初衷在於，即使社會給不出半點慈悲，兩個絕望之人仍有愛的可能， 「電影裡有許多元素，包含非法殘障中心、父權暴力等，但我想讓觀眾看到兩人相遇的狀態，我希望在電影之後，大家對他們這樣的人，可以有更多的理解。」

《黑潮》經由雪虹和阿忠，照見晦暗現實裡的邊緣人群，與「如何生」、「何以生」之間的徒勞。電影終幕為觀眾留下想像的空間，也似是池家慶給予角色的一絲溫柔。然而，我們能否以如此樂觀的心態，看待雪虹和阿忠的相遇，並稱其為「暗裡有光」，一種（可能的）救贖？

池家慶回擲問題：如何理解阿忠最後的選擇呢？對社會的恨？抑或自我的放逐？ 「我自己在寫的時候，那個舉動或許是他做過最勇敢的事情了。他一輩子都被推著走，好像什麼都沒做過，所以我覺得那一剎那，他是為了阿忠和雪虹，對我來講，那是（去）愛的體現。」

然而，他同時也認為，兩人之間所謂的「愛」，未必能稱為「救贖」。更準確地說，是兩個不被社會理解、卻能相互理解之人，會再相遇後有機會長出愛人的「能力」，短暫地溫暖彼此。

《釀電影》，「如果月亮背面是汪洋，日光就是生命的海流──金馬 63 專題」主視覺。／圖像提供：釀電影（設計：林雅萱）

月亮是最古早的電視，而電影百年的靈光， 是被迫倒下的巨樹身後，有眾人為祂記憶。

如果月亮背面是汪洋， 日光就是生命的海流。

article_text:
Looks like “ Artificial ” is the real thing.

Luca Guadagnino’s genre-blending movie about the evils of artificial intelligence (and one of its fathers, Sam Altman) had a triumphant U.K. premiere at the London Film Festival on Sunday. The director, standing beside key cast members Andrew Garfield and Yura Borisov, received thunderous applause at Royal Festival Hall.

The British event followed the world premiere of “Artificial” a week earlier at the New York Film Festival. It was a make-or-break moment for a project plagued by scandal after Amazon MGM punted the film off its summer slate. Worse was what came after: an odious whisper campaign saying the film stank (anonymous sources dismissed it as only worthy of a streaming release, according to a July report). But the Big Apple swallowed the film with rapture.

Related Stories

Joel Coen Teases Reunion Film With Brother Ethan: There Are ‘Other Stories That We’ve Thought About’

Cannes Chief Thierry Fremaux Hails French Film Model as CNC Head Gaëtan Bruel Vows to Fight for Its Future at 80th Anniversary

“So this is a dawn-of-a-new-world story, as well as a backstabbing corporate business story, and also a horror movie, in which AI emerges from the lab as a sinister serpent,” wrote Variety chief critic Owen Gleiberman in his review, calling the movie a “brilliant but playful docudrama, meticulously true to history.”

Others agree. The title has a 96% Fresh rating on review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes, representing the highest score of Guadagnino’s career across 11 feature film releases. Garfield has been catapulted to the front of the best supporting actor race, thanks to a performance that delivers “a masterclass in diabolical villainy,” according to another review.

The notices, the standing ovations, the awards buzz — all of it represents a stunning reversal of fortune for Guadagnino after the Amazon debacle in June. It was highly uncommon, in Hollywood terms, for even a tech-owned content studio to kill a project it had cradled since infancy. Neon rescued the movie with a global rights deal shortly after the Amazon rift.

“We believe that ‘Artificial’ will be better served if it were released by a different studio,” the e-commerce giant said at the time. Global press almost unanimously noted that the decision to jettison the movie came only three months after Amazon signed a significant partnership with Altman’s OpenAI (including a $50 billion investment in the company).

But, per Variety’ s sources, the writing is on the wall. Nothing was wrong with “Artificial,” and the response underlines the dubiousness of Amazon’s decision to drop it.

“Wasn’t this supposed to be god-awful?” wondered one film executive at a rival studio. The exec didn’t just raise an eyebrow at Amazon MGM, but at other legacy distributors who were in the mix to take the project before Neon won out. “A reaction this strong just shows you, every studio pretending the film wasn’t releasable is just conflicted out by their own investments in AI.”

In July, New York magazine published a piece citing individuals close to the project as saying it “lacked theater-worthy criteria.” That doesn’t quite track with early audience response. In fact, the critical consensus is that “Artificial” — not Aaron Sorkin’s “The Social Reckoning,” which debuted last weekend via Sony Pictures — is a worthy spiritual successor to David Fincher’s “The Social Network.” It’s hard to imagine Amazon not being pleased with this response had it kept “Artificial.”

Interestingly, Amazon’s headaches at the intersection of talent and AI are not exclusive to the Guadagnino movie. At New York Comic Con last weekend, actor Nicolas Cage made waves when he disclosed that he refused to sign a document permitting the studio to use AI in and around his likeness on its now-canceled original series “Spider-Noir.”

“I am not an AI-friendly actor. I’m not a member of their club. I didn’t sign the waiver,” Cage said. “I’m probably not going to be working with that studio again.” There’s a bit more to this story, insiders close to “Spider-Noir” said. Cage was referring to a form from the show’s producer, Sony Pictures Television, considered “industry standard” on content shoots. The waiver gives the studio permission to create a duplicate of an actor in costume, which aids in VFX work during postproduction. Actors are free to opt out, and the form is said to be in line with SAG-AFTRA guidelines.

But it won’t be the end of talent bristling over the coming AI revolution — at Amazon or elsewhere. One creative team member on an Amazon MGM series tells Variety that AI training is a requirement on the lot these days.

The source describes a “mandatory and perfunctory meeting” with the company’s AI team, billed as standard workplace education that corporations regularly hold around sexual harassment and fire safety. The AI group spent an hour pitching the creatives on a suite of products it referred to as “tools.” Our source says, however, it became clear that these tools could “eliminate entire jobs” on the production. Amazon MGM declined to comment on the matter.

More telling, per the source, is that the show’s corporate stewards from Amazon also sat through the training “stone-faced.” While the individual won’t name the execs in attendance, they found it “collectively embarrassing for everyone to be doing this, including on the Amazon side.” A source with direct knowledge of Amazon’s process said such meetings are not mandatory, and humans guide every part of the process related to the tools.

And so begins the great sacrifice the major studios are about to make in service of computer-based cost efficiencies and the “move fast and break things” bravado of Silicon Valley. Time will tell if a prompt can make content that’s as buzzy and well positioned as “Artificial.”

Source: Dick Thomas Johnson, Wiki Commons CC BY 2.0

Yamazaki Takashi (cropped)

Takashi Yamazaki, the Japanese Oscar-winning director of Godzilla Minus One and the upcoming Godzilla Minus Zero , will make his English-language debut on Grandgear for Sony Pictures. JJ Abrams’ Bad Robot is producing.

Sam Nivola and Nico Parker have joined the production, and Paul Giamatti, who stars in A24’s awards hopeful The Debut , is understood to be in talks to join the cast. Yamazaki wrote the original screenplay however plot details remain under the proverbial wraps. Glen Zipper is producing alongside Abrams.

Yamazaki became the first director since Stanley Kubrick to win a visual effects Oscar with Godzilla Minus One in 2024. That film grossed $113m worldwide and Yamazaki’s follow-up, Godzilla Minus Zero , is scheduled to open in the US on November 6 through GKids.

Nivola earned an Actor Award nomination for The White Lotus and has starred in White Noise and Maestro . He stars in Hulu’s mystery series Phony that just premiered in the US.

UK actress Nico won the 2024 Sundance US Dramatic special jury award for breakthrough performance award for Searchlight’s Suncoast , and was nominated for a 2024 supporting actress Bafta for HBO series The Last Of Us . She also played the female lead in DreamWorks Animation’s live-action How To Train Your Dragon .

"这种视角也将《永远与你同行》置于意大利悠久的电影传统之中——即利用儿童来探讨更宏大的社会与情感现实。卡塔尼将维托里奥·德·西卡的《偷自行车的人》称为“绝对杰作”，同时形容他自己的影片在场景、方言及其他本土根植的元素上具有鲜明的意大利特色。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "影片于秋季在卡拉布里亚拍摄，该地位于意大利半岛靴子形状的“鞋尖”，这让该地区的森林本身就成为了一个角色。然而卡塔尼相信这个故事能够走向远方，因为其核心体验超越了意大利的背景。他说：“它能走向国际，因为失去母亲是一个将全世界凝聚在一起的主题。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "卡塔尼此前已在洛迦诺电影节上展示过这部电影，但他对中东年轻观众会作何反应感到好奇。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他指出：“我对这种文化并不那么深入了解，所以我想了解观众的反应。让我印象深刻的是，看到孩子们在放映结束后走过来感谢我、向我道贺，并告诉我这部电影让他们多么激动。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对卡塔尼而言，他们的反应印证了一个贯穿他作品的想法。他说：“与我们非常亲近的人（比如父母）相关的情感，以及与爱相关的情感，将全世界凝聚在一起。对我来说，电影必须植根于情感。一个故事必须是情感化的。否则，我对此不感兴趣。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "卡塔尼还认为，在意大利独立电影面临日益严峻的财务压力之际，像SIFF这样的电影节可以充当意大利与阿拉伯电影工业之间的潜在桥梁。除了文化交流，他希望更紧密的联系最终能延伸到制作和融资领域。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "然而，他的下一部电影将让他重返成人主角。该项目以卡塔尼长大的托斯卡纳卡拉拉大理石采石场为背景，聚焦于“乡村医生”（medico condotto），即曾经服务于意大利小型社区、其角色随着该国医疗系统变革而消失的村医。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "但卡塔尼已经在开发另一个将带他回到年轻主角身边的项目。《年轻叛逆者》改编自真实故事，讲述了一群年轻童子军不理会法西斯对天主教协会的禁令、秘密继续活动，并帮助成千上万遭到该政权针对的人穿过群山逃往瑞士的故事。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "卡塔尼说：“这是一部讲述自由的电影。他们反抗这种强制规定，决定拥抱自由并帮助那些正在遭受迫害的人。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在《永远与你同行》之后，卡塔尼计划继续探讨以童年为中心的故事。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他主张：“我认为孩子们有很多话要说，也有很多东西可以给予成年人。如今的年轻人有着令人难以置信的成熟。”", "translated": true}]

article_text:
Italian filmmaker Fabrizio Cattani brought “Forever With You,” his exploration of childhood, grief and the loss of a parent, to the Middle East for the first time this week, with the film receiving a Green Carpet premiere at the 13th Sharjah Intl. Film Festival for Children and Youth in the UAE.

With Italy celebrated as this year’s Country of Honor, the festival has put a spotlight on the country’s cinema. For Cattani, “Forever With You” also marks a turn toward younger audiences after previous films centered on more difficult adult subjects.

'Beast in Me' Season 2 Casts John Goodman

Adapted from an Italian novel of the same name, “Forever With You” follows Filo, a young boy struggling to understand the death of his mother. Set in 1998 and told through flashbacks, the film turns his journey through grief into an adventure in which the people around him represent different parts of his inner world.

“Filo, the protagonist, represents our rational part. Rullo, his friend, is the emotional part. The father is the mature part, Amelie is the childish part and Guelpho is the scary part,” Cattani tells Variety . “All these parts are inside of us. I liked using these symbols to deal with such a delicate subject as mourning.”

For Cattani, childhood offered a way into that subject precisely because of the innocence with which Filo encounters the world.

“He observes the world through the eyes of innocence, which we unfortunately lose when we grow up,” the director explains. “It allows him to have the strength to explore and understand the importance of small things, the things that have value.”

“Childhood is very powerful because that’s where the person starts,” he adds. “Everything develops from what people experience in their childhood, what they receive in their education and what they see. We are sponges as children. What we absorb, we transmit in the later stages of our lives.”

That perspective also places “Forever With You” within a longstanding Italian cinematic tradition of using children to explore larger social and emotional realities. Cattani points to Vittorio De Sica’s “Bicycle Thieves” as an “absolute masterpiece,” while describing his own film as distinctly Italian in its setting, dialects and other locally rooted elements.

Shot in the autumn in Calabria, the “toe” at the end of the Italian peninsula’s boot, the film makes the region’s forests a character in their own right. Yet Cattani believes the story can travel because its central experience transcends its Italian setting. “It can open up internationally because the loss of a mother is a theme that unites the whole world,” he says.

Cattani had already presented the film at the Locarno Film Festival, but was curious about how young audiences in the Middle East would respond to it.

“I don’t know this culture so deeply, so I wanted to understand the reaction of the audience,” he notes. “What impressed me was seeing the kids after the screening come to thank me, congratulate me and tell me how excited they were by the film.”

For Cattani, their reaction reinforced an idea that runs throughout his work. “The emotions connected to people very close to us, like a parent, and connected to love, unite the whole world,” he says. “For me, cinema must be emotionally rooted. A story must be emotional. Otherwise, I’m not interested.”

Cattani also sees festivals such as SIFF as potential bridges between the Italian and Arab film industries at a moment when he says independent filmmaking in Italy faces increasing financial pressure. Beyond cultural exchange, he hopes stronger ties could eventually extend to production and financing.

His next film, however, takes him back toward an adult protagonist. Set around the marble quarries of Carrara in Tuscany, where Cattani grew up, the project centers on the “medico condotto,” the village doctors who once served small Italian communities and whose role disappeared following changes to the country’s health system.

But Cattani is already developing another project that would bring him back to young protagonists. “Young Rebels” is based on the true story of a group of young scouts who defied a fascist ban on Catholic associations and continued their activities in secret, helping thousands of people targeted by the regime escape across the mountains into Switzerland.

“It is a film that talks about freedom,” Cattani says. “They rebelled against this imposition and decided to embrace freedom and help people who were being persecuted.”

After “Forever With You,” Cattani plans to continue exploring stories centered on childhood.

“I think children have a lot to say and a lot to give to adults,” he argues. “Today’s young people have an incredible maturity.”

article_text:
Since 2016, out of personal interest and in a scavenger hunt manner, we at Matca have been building a collection of photography publications in and about Vietnam, prioritising works by Vietnamese nationals and including ones removed from the official narrative. Different types of photography, originally intended for different uses, were gathered, including books, catalogues, periodicals, prints and ephemera. As revealed by their discolouration and worn edges, many of these materials have lived interesting lives, recently retrieved from overseas or found via informal second-hand stores stacked alongside other vintage knickknacks.

Entitled The Unofficial Archive, this project presents a selection from the collection, divided into Books and Ephemera . Included are materials spanning photojournalism, fine art, and commercial photography, printed within and outside the country, including places like Hong Kong, Japan, and the Soviet Union. With dates of publication ranging from the 1950s to the present day, the selection encompasses a variety of issues and visual tropes through a pivotal moment in Vietnam’s national and photographic history as the country emerged from the aftermath of colonialism followed by the Vietnam War, known domestically as the Resistance War against America. Works and practices from this period continue to inspire explorations in recently published titles. Taken together, they demonstrate the varied roles that photography has played in Vietnam, from a nation-building device to a tool for self-expression.

After its debut at BoP Festival 2023 in Bristol, The Unofficial Archive catalogue has been re-designed and is now available in both Vietnamese and English. From 04-06.04.2025, Matca Space for Photography will host a special showcase featuring original materials from the collection alongside community events.

An initial attempt to activate materials haphazardly amassed through the years, The Unofficial Archive remains open-ended with a view to sparking further public interest. We hope you’ll join us in this ongoing exploration of Vietnam’s photographic heritage.

editorial_excerpt_zh: 埃诺斯·马福卡特（Enos Mafokate）的职业生涯始于马厩工，并在种族隔离时期成长为世界级运动员。2026年9月，埃诺斯在约翰内斯堡逝世，享年80岁——但他的精神遗产通过他的马术学校以及他所启发的代代学员得以延续。在……

"尽管埃诺斯对他训练和照料的马匹产生了深厚的感情，但由于肤色原因，以职业障碍赛骑手的身份参赛似乎是不可能的。作为生活在种族隔离制度下的儿童，埃诺斯甚至在骑白人的马被抓后面临着被捕的威胁。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": {"type": "paragraph", "text": "种族隔离制度瓦解不久后，埃诺斯作为南非体育大使出席了在巴塞罗那举行的1992年奥运会，在跨越每一个障碍的同时打破了壁垒与刻板印象。2006年，他创立了一家非营利组织——索韦托马术中心，为年轻的黑人骑手提供进入一个长期试图将他们排斥在外的世界的机会。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/2651f0d6a342ba0fa953fdb394140be334640a0e/0_0_3200_2134/master/3200.jpg?width=465&dpr=1&s=none&crop=none", "alt": "五个孩子在索韦托马术中心的木栅栏旁观看马术骑手", "caption": "2024年，南非庆祝了民主化30周年，但种族隔离的废除并未根除种族主义或不平等。针对黑人社区的系统性压迫仍然很常见，尤其是在体育界。对许多南非人来说，参与体育运动是一种明确的政治行为。在种族隔离时期的几十年里，南非因拒绝将队伍去种族化而被禁止参加奥运会和世界杯等国际赛事。一项运动的多元化程度往往是一个国家政治进步的指标——然而，南非正饱受全球最高失业率的困扰。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/ec27d18db878dd341a3d5ea1b65321220276304a/0_0_3200_2133/master/3200.jpg?width=445&dpr=1&s=none&crop=none", "alt": "https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/710a416a5551605435a8cf51e6b9dd3d32de5d87/0_0_3000_2000/master/3000.jpg?width=445&dpr=1&s=none&crop=none", "alt": "滕宾科西帮助莱谢迪·马苏库坐上白马的马鞍", "caption": "莱谢迪·马苏库（Lesedi "马术这项精英运动需要发展中社区所不具备的财富。排他性的财务壁垒与收入差距的现实，与南非的种族不平等并行存在。马福卡特展示了一生中克服逆境的经历，然而随着年龄的增长，他在马术界继续面临着带有种族色彩的微小歧视（microaggressions）——在某些情况下甚至是露骨的种族主义。在2017年的一场比赛中，一名保安走近他，要求他出示正装进拖车的马匹的所有权证明。", "translated": article_text:
In a historically wealthy sport dominated by the white elite and plagued by its colonial reign, a Black athlete draped in a red coat represented his nation.

This is the remarkable story of Enos Mafokate and the legacy he worked so hard to create. A professional equestrian rider, Enos began his career as a stable hand and went on to become a world-class athlete during the apartheid era in South Africa .

Though Enos developed a deep love for the horses he trained and nurtured, competing as a professional show jumper seemed out of the question because of the colour of his skin. As a child living under apartheid, Enos was even faced with the threat of arrest after being caught riding a white man’s horse.

Still, despite racial tension and oppressive segregation laws, in 1975, Enos was able to overcome these hurdles to become South Africa’s first Black showjumper.

Soon after apartheid was dismantled, Enos attended the 1992 Olympic Games in Barcelona as a sports ambassador for South Africa, breaking down barriers and stereotypes as he cleared each obstacle. In 2006, he founded a non-profit organisation, the Soweto Equestrian Centre, to provide young Black riders access to a world that had long sought to exclude them.

With the aim to improve the welfare of people in South Africa’s largest township, Soweto, and to open up the elite world of horse riding to those who cannot afford access, the Soweto Equestrian Centre has become a pillar for the community. It remains the world’s only township-based equestrian centre.

In September 2026, at the age of 80, Enos died in Johannesburg. His legacy, and his horse-riding school, continues to live on through the generations he inspired.

In 2024 South Africa commemorated 30 years of democracy, but the abolishment of apartheid has not eradicated racism or inequality. Systematic oppression of Black communities is still common, especially within sport. For many South Africans, participation in sport is an explicitly political act. For decades during apartheid, South Africa was barred from international competitions such as the Olympics and the World Cup because of its refusal to desegregate teams. How much a sport has diversified is often an indicator of a nation’s political progress – however, South Africa is plagued by the world’s highest unemployment rate.

Over 30 years of democracy, post-apartheid governments have made promises of ushering in development, yet South Africa has an official unemployment rate of 33%, and many young graduates are jobless or trying to make ends meet working menial jobs.

The elite sport of equestrian riding requires wealth that developing communities do not have. The reality of exclusive financial barriers and income gaps run parallel with South Africa’s racial inequality. Mafokate demonstrated a life of overcoming adversities, yet as he got older he continued to face racially charged microaggressions – and in some cases blatant racism within the equestrian milieu. At a competition in 2017 he was approached by a security guard who asked him to show proof of ownership of the horse he was loading into his trailer.

The centre welcomes all ages to learn the benefits of developing relationships with horses, imploring young Black children to embark on a journey that is often inaccessible to Black communities in South Africa. Decolonising Black communities’ relationship to horses is a vital lesson shared at the centre.

Asked what obstacles Black riders in South Africa face, Mafokate said it came down to culture and cost. In Soweto, horses are a symbol of labour, reduced to haulers. The lack of exposure to horses outside these historical labour roles, not to mention the exorbitant fees students must pay to participate, perpetuates Black communities’ exclusion from equestrian sports. In a country where more than 40% of workers are paid less than £150 a month, Mafokate’s equestrian school is free.

Young riders pay their dues by helping to care for the 20 horses at the centre. The impact this accessibility has had on the Black youth of Soweto has been immense, allowing them to realise their dreams of competing in a historically colonial sport.

article_text:
Curry Barker ’s first post-“Obsession” film project, “Mama Bear,” has debuted exclusively on YouTube, giving horror fans a fix just in time for Halloween.

The short film, announced just days earlier in partnership with Windows, immediately sparked intrigue from audiences, with some interpreting its title as a nod to “Obsession,” Barker’s breakout film, since one of the main characters is named Bear (played by Michael Johnston).

Related Stories

Fox and Endemol Shine Team to Adapt 'Fear Factor' as a Scripted Microdrama Series for My Drama App

Fox's $22 Billion Roku Deal Approved by Shareholders of Both Companies

“Obsession” is one of the year’s biggest box-office hits, grossing $519 million worldwide on a budget of less than $1 million. The film was also critically adored and has earned Oscar buzz for Inde Navarrette, who starred as Nikki, Bear’s crush, whom he makes fall for him with the help of a mysterious toy called the “One Wish Willow.”

Following the success of the film, Navarrette was cast as Rogue in Marvel’s “X-Men” reboot , while Barker signed an eight-figure deal with Universal and Blumhouse. Before “Obsession,” Barker had risen to prominence acting and directing in YouTube videos.

For those looking for something longer from Barker, the director has “Anything But Ghosts,” the Focus Features and Blumhouse-Atomic Monster-backed horror-comedy, set for release on May 7, 2027. Barker directs the film and co-wrote the script with his “ Obsession ” star and longtime collaborator Cooper Tomlinson. The pair are also co-leads in the project, starring alongside Violet McGraw, Chris Reinacher, Bryce Dallas Howard and Aaron Paul.

“When a group of fame-seeking wannabe ‘ghosthunters’ find themselves in over their heads, things spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control,” reads the film’s official logline.

article_text:
Von Karin Sander bis Heinz Mack: Die Evangelische Kirche versteigert am 14. November in Berlin 52 Werke zeitgenössischer Kunst. Die Einnahmen unterstützen unter anderem Projekte für Geflüchtete

Schauplatz der 31. EKBOart-Kunstauktion ist die St.-Matthäus-Kirche am Berliner Kulturforum. Dort werden am 14. November um 18 Uhr unter anderem Arbeiten von Thomas Scheibitz, Karin Sander, Rimini Protokoll, Heinz Mack und A K Dolven versteigert. Kooperationspartner ist das Auktionshaus Grisebach.

Eine Jury hat die 52 Werke ausgewählt. Neben etablierten Kunstschaffenden sind Nachwuchspositionen aus Berliner Hochschulen sowie Künstlerinnen und Künstler aus dem Umfeld der Geflüchtetenarbeit vertreten. Vom 6. bis 14. November können die Arbeiten jeweils dienstags bis sonntags von 11 bis 18 Uhr in der Kirche besichtigt werden. Der Auktionskatalog ist online abrufbar, Gebote können auch schriftlich eingereicht werden.

Die Einnahmen kommen kirchlichen Projekten von und mit Geflüchteten und Migranten sowie den beteiligten Kunstschaffenden zugute. In den vergangenen Jahren wurden unter anderem Asyl in der Kirche, die Seenotrettungsorganisation SOS Mediterranée und Jugendbegegnungen in Neutrebbin unterstützt. Die Evangelische Kirche Berlin-Brandenburg-schlesische-Oberlausitz veranstaltet die Auktion seit 1996 unter dem Motto "Kunst hilft helfen".

article_text:
東京ステーションギャラリー（東京都千代田区）から、2027年の展覧会スケジュールが発表されました。

今回は、2027年以降に開催される、「ニコライ・アストルップ 創造する庭」「生誕140年記念 染織家 山鹿清華 宙翔ぶイマジネーション」「 秦 テルヲ 聖と俗（仮称）」「シカゴ 写真と越境（仮称）」「 梶田半古 （仮称）」「エレン・テスレフ（仮称）」「藤井達吉 自然への憧憬（仮称）」と、7つの展覧会についてその概要が公開されました。

リニューアルオープンから15年目を迎える東京ステーションギャラリーでは、「特別なことは何もしません。いつもどおり全力投球で質の高い展覧会を開催し続けます。見る喜び、発見する楽しみを味わってください」としています。そこでここまで判明した各展覧会の概要について、それぞれまとめました。

東京ステーションギャラリー

所在地：東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1

開館時間：10:00～18:00（金曜日は～20:00）※入館は閉館30分前まで

休館日：月曜日（祝日の場合は翌平日休館／ただし会期最終週、ゴールデンウィーク・お盆・シルバーウィーク期間中の月曜日は開館）、年末年始、展示替期間

観覧料：展覧会ごとに異なります。詳細は公式サイトをご確認ください。

アクセス：JR東京駅丸の内北口改札前

詳細は、 東京ステーションギャラリー公式サイト まで。

ニコライ・アストルップ 創造する庭

2026年11月21日（土）～2027年1月31日（日）

20世紀初頭のノルウェーで最も傑出した画家の一人として、近年、世界的にも評価が高まっているニコライ・アストルップ（Nikolai Astrup/1880-1928）の日本初の回顧展です。彼は、険しい山々と湖に囲まれた西ノルウェーの故郷・ヨルステルを拠点に、天候や季節ごとに変化する自然と人々の暮らしを描き続けました。さらに本展では、油彩画に加え、独自の境地を拓いた木版画、再評価が進むテキスタイルデザインのなどの代表作を一堂に集め、その画業の全貌に迫ります。

生誕140年記念 染織家 山鹿清華 宙翔ぶイマジネーション

2027年2月20日～4月11日

山鹿清華（1885-1981）は、京都で西陣織の図案と日本画を学び、神坂雪佳に師事してさらに創作の幅を広げました。図案、糸の選択、織りに至る工程をひとりで行う「手織錦」を考案し、伝統的な図柄から、時代を映す奇抜なモチーフまで自由に表現しました。明治、大正、昭和にわたり活躍した染織家・山鹿清華の仕事を振り返る40年ぶりの回顧展です。

秦 テルヲ 聖と俗（仮称）

2027年4月29日～6月20日

日本各地を転々としながら描き続けた漂泊の画家、秦テルヲ（1887-1945）。労働者や娼婦など底辺に生きる人々の姿を生々しく描き、デカダンの画家と呼ばれました。一方で、清らかな仏画や母子像を繰り返し描いています。東京で初公開となる《吉原長巻》は、震災で焼失したと思われていた幻の作品ですが、吉原の光と影を鮮やかに描き出した画家の最高傑作です。この機会をぜひお見逃しなく。

シカゴ 写真と越境（仮称）

2027年7月3日～8月29日

20世紀のシカゴで活躍した、日本とアメリカ双方にルーツをもつ5人の写真家を紹介します。ジュン・フジタ、ハリー・K・シゲタ、井高雄一、石元泰博、タダオ・タカノ。報道写真、商業写真、ニュー・バウハウスの実験など、多彩な表現を通して、日本とアメリカにまたがる経験のなかで育まれた彼らの創造をたどります。5人の足跡から、トランスナショナルな写真史の一断章を浮かび上がらせます。

梶田半古 （仮称）

2027年9月18日～11月7日

明治から大正にかけて活躍した日本画家、梶田半古（1870-1917）。文学・歴史や有職故実などの深い教養に裏打ちされ、卓越した描写力と抜群のデザイン感覚で描かれたその作品は、同時代の日本画の中でもひときわ品格を感じさせます。また、挿絵や口絵、絵葉書などの「卓上芸術」にも並々ならぬ精力を注ぎ、多くの優れた作品を残しました。出版文化という面からもたいへん興味深い作家です。

エレン・テスレフ（仮称）

2027年11月27日～2028年2月13日

エレン・テスレフ（Ellen Thesleff/1869-1954）は、19世紀フィンランド絵画の黄金時代に活躍した画家です。美術の世界で女性が認められることの少なかった時代に、国境を越えて活動し、母国に最新の潮流をもたらした先駆者の一人となりました。このたびの日本初個展では、テスレフの創作の源となった「旅」に着目し、優れた色彩画家にして木版画の革新者であり、抽象表現にも挑んだ画家の歩みを辿ります。

藤井達吉 自然への憧憬（仮称）

2028年3月4日～5月21日

工芸、絵画、図案など、ジャンルを越えて創作を続けた藤井達吉。伝統的な技法に学びながら独自の表現を生み出し、やがて生活空間そのものをデザインする試みへと活動を広げていきました。本展では、新たに見つかった工芸作品や初公開の絵画を交え、芸術を暮らしの中へ広げようとした彼の普及活動にも目を向けながら、自然への憧れに貫かれた藤井芸術の全貌をひもときます。

ノルウェーの雄大な自然を描いたニコライ・アストルップに始まり、約40年ぶりとなる山鹿清華の回顧展、幻の大作《吉原長巻》が初公開される秦テルヲ展、そして日米の架け橋となったシカゴの写真家たちや気品あふれる美人画で知られる梶田半古、フィンランド絵画の黄金時代に活躍した先駆者エレン・テスレフ、工芸と暮らしを結びつけた藤井達吉まで、多彩で意外性に満ちたラインナップが揃いました。2027年の東京ステーションギャラリーも、アートファンに多くの新鮮な驚きと「見る喜び、発見する楽しみを」をもたらしてくれそうです。（美術展ナビ）

article_text:
From teargas in Paris to gen Z in Germany: protests across Europe – in pictures

Demonstrations over the high cost of living and inequality spread from France to Germany and Albania

A protester stands next to police officers during a nationwide protest by campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen Z takes charge) in Cologne, Germany. Photograph: Thilo Schmülgen/Reuters

A protester waves a French flag amid teargas smoke while taking part in a nationwide demonstration over the rising cost of living and inequality organised by the gilets jaunes (Yellow Vest) movement, labour unions and high school and university students, in Lyon, France Photograph: Jeff Pachoud/AFP/Getty Images

A protester dressed as the Joker in handcuffs in Paris amid an ‘exceptional’ security deployment with 70,000 police officers and gendarmes mobilisedPhotograph: Sameer Al-Doumy/AFP/Getty Images

A protester with a Statue of Liberty hat and fake blood on his hands stands next to police officers during a nationwide protest by campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen Z takes charge) in Cologne, GermanyPhotograph: Thilo Schmülgen/Reuters

Flames rise after a petrol bomb lands next to a police water cannon truck during an anti-government protest in Tirana, AlbaniaPhotograph: Florion Goga/Reuters

A woman poses with a ‘Gen Z takes care of it’ placard in front of the Brandenburg Gate during a protest in Berlin, GermanyPhotograph: Ebrahim Noroozi/AP

title_original: Downtown, Behind the Scenes of the City
editorial_excerpt_zh: 亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis Duclos）带着胶片徕卡相机漫步于城市中，寻找意料之外的风景。如果说他的首个展览“En Ville”（意为“在城中”）捕捉到了巴黎街头的诗意，那么“Downtown”则将他的目光延伸至其他地平线。他构建了一个颗粒感生动的单色系列，其中黑白对比使光线成为这场都市漫游的引导线……

Ville”（意为“在城中”）捕捉到了巴黎街头的诗意，那么“Downtown”则将他的目光延伸至其他地平线。他构建了一个颗粒感生动的单色系列，其中黑白对比使光线成为这场都市漫游的引导线。太阳升起，洒满巴黎的建筑立面，在全盛时期炽烈照耀着东京的大道，随后其最后一缕余晖羞涩地抚过纽约的建筑：贯穿20幅摄影作品，展览本身化为了一场与摄影师自身相映衬的漫游。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我们在毫无过渡的情况下从一个大都市穿梭到另一个大都市，被同一根将世界各地街道连接在一起的无形之线所承载。归根结底，一张照片拍摄于何处并不重要，因为城市以同样的叠句摇晃着我们，仿佛所有城市都共享一种只有眼睛才能揭示的共同语言。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "credit": "Blind Magazine", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "从封面图像开始，亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis Duclos）便向我们展示了宏伟的城市与普通的躯体共享同一片天空。一个如拱门般弯曲的膝盖，一只环抱其上的手。下方是一排弓起的脊背、赤裸的肩膀、在水边晃荡的双腿，而在远处的背景中，那个守护着巴黎的“铁娘子”显得微小而又略带羞涩。在这个肉体化为风景的超大前景中，我们陷入了一种几乎是不体面的亲密构图。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "摄影师玩味着尺寸，转换着比例，邀请我们以不同的方式去观看。游乐场变成了一场好莱坞式的奇观，一个纸扎的金刚化为了旋转木马的无声守护者，在人群上方隐现，大张着嘴发出无声的咆哮，伸出一臂指向天空，仿佛要去摘取那些在金属缆绳末端旋转的身影。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "一切从来都不是表面看起来的那样，建筑立面有时会变成后台。题为《Ascension》的这幅图像就是如此，其中一个服务楼梯的巨大阴影在金属栅栏上展开。我们看到的只是楼梯的倒影，一个带有着剧场般光影的幽灵般投影版本。仿佛建筑自身在注视着自己，而投下的阴影成了唯一能够最终上演真实奇观的舞台。这是一个配得上戏剧或电影的布景，让人很难不联想到《楚门的世界》（The Truman Show）。人们几乎以为会看到那个角色在攀爬途中抵达顶部，转向观众，最后鞠躬谢幕，并说出那句台词：“早上好，下午好，晚安。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4252-1024x960.jpeg", "heading", "text": "胶片摄影，回归本源", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "二十多年来，亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis Duclos）一直工作在时事的核心。自1985年起，在美联社（Associated Press）短暂工作后，他加入伽马图片社（Gamma agency），在那里报道了冲突、政治新闻、体育以及重大国际事件。作为一位屡获殊荣的摄影师，他的创作实践以其所探索领域的多元化为标志。2005年，随着纪实摄影经历重大变革，他决定离开伽马图片社，投身于独立项目，在纪实摄影和视听制作之间游走。随后，多年来他逐渐远离报道摄影，重新找回了摆脱经济与编辑约束的纯粹摄影乐趣。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如同一个漫游者（flâneur），亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis Duclos）任由偶然引导自己。他没有明显的行程规划地向前迈进，留心着那些逃过匆忙目光的事物。对他而言，摄影意味着学会在正确的时刻去观看、构图并按下快门。他的摄影风格distinctive，建立在严谨的构图之上，其中每个元素都找到了自己的位置并为图像的意义做出贡献。“我用光线和构图来表达一个我希望能够引发情感的时刻。正是在那个时候，一张照片可以对我说话，可以对我们说话。或者不说话。它既简单又复杂。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4251-797x1024.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Downtown © Alexis Duclos", "credit": "Blind Magazine", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4250-805x1024.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Downtown © Alexis Duclos", "credit": "Blind Magazine", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4253-1024x805.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Downtown © Alexis Duclos", "credit": "Blind Magazine", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "摄影师给自己施加的唯一限制是他对焦距的选择：一颗50mm镜头，其成像效果最接近人眼的感知。亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis Duclos）完全使用胶片进行创作：“我热爱黑白胶片，因为它的颗粒、质感、物质属性以及美学。”在他看来，与数码摄影和人工智能（其中图像可以被重新组合或人工生成）不同，胶片体现了对植根于底片物质性的摄影实践的回归，这是一个时刻确实存在过的无可辩驳的标志。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在这里，我们含蓄地发现罗兰·巴特（Roland Barthes）对摄影指示性力量的直觉：图像作为痕迹，作为某物确实曾存在于镜头之前的证明，存在于一个将永不再重现的光线和瞬间中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "由亚历克西·迪克洛（Alexis article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Armed with his film Leica, Alexis Duclos roams the city in search of the unexpected. Where his first exhibition, “En Ville” (“In the City”), captured the poetry of Parisian streets, “Downtown” extends his gaze to other horizons. He builds a monochrome series with a vibrant grain, in which black and white contrasts make light the guiding thread of this urban wandering. The sun rises and floods a Parisian facade, blazes over a Tokyo boulevard at its zenith, then its last rays timidly caress a New York building: across 20 photographs, the exhibition itself becomes a wandering that mirrors the photographer’s own."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "We move from one metropolis to another without transition, carried by the same invisible thread linking streets across the world. In the end, it hardly matters where an image was taken, since the city rocks us with the same refrain, as if all cities shared a common language that only the eye could reveal."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Larger than life"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4677-681x1024.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Downtown © Alexis Duclos", "credit": "Blind Magazine"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.blind-magazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/img-4676-681x1024.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Downtown © Alexis Duclos", "credit": "Blind Magazine"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "From the cover image on, Alexis Duclos shows us that the monumental city and ordinary bodies share the same sky. A knee bent like an arch, a hand wrapped around it. Below, a row of curved backs, bare shoulders, legs dangling at the water’s edge, and far in the background, tiny, almost shy, the iron lady watching over Paris. In this oversized foreground, where flesh becomes landscape, we are plunged into the almost indecent intimacy of the framing."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The photographer plays with dimensions, shifting scales, inviting us to look differently. The fairground is transformed into a Hollywood spectacle, where a papier-mâché King Kong, turned silent guardian of a carousel, looms above the crowd, jaws open on a silent roar, reaching an arm toward the sky as if to pluck the silhouettes spinning at the end of their metal cables."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Nothing is ever quite what it seems, and facades sometimes turn into backstage. That is the case with this image, titled Ascension, where the giant shadow of a service staircase unfolds across a metal fence. We see only the staircase’s reflection, a ghostly, projected version, theatrically lit. article_text:
Armed with his film Leica, Alexis Duclos roams the city in search of the unexpected. Where his first exhibition, “En Ville” (“In the City”), captured the poetry of Parisian streets, “Downtown” extends his gaze to other horizons. He builds a monochrome series with a vibrant grain, in which black and white contrasts make light the guiding thread of this urban wandering. The sun rises and floods a Parisian facade, blazes over a Tokyo boulevard at its zenith, then its last rays timidly caress a New York building: across 20 photographs, the exhibition itself becomes a wandering that mirrors the photographer’s own.

We move from one metropolis to another without transition, carried by the same invisible thread linking streets across the world. In the end, it hardly matters where an image was taken, since the city rocks us with the same refrain, as if all cities shared a common language that only the eye could reveal.

Larger than life

From the cover image on, Alexis Duclos shows us that the monumental city and ordinary bodies share the same sky. A knee bent like an arch, a hand wrapped around it. Below, a row of curved backs, bare shoulders, legs dangling at the water’s edge, and far in the background, tiny, almost shy, the iron lady watching over Paris. In this oversized foreground, where flesh becomes landscape, we are plunged into the almost indecent intimacy of the framing.

The photographer plays with dimensions, shifting scales, inviting us to look differently. The fairground is transformed into a Hollywood spectacle, where a papier-mâché King Kong, turned silent guardian of a carousel, looms above the crowd, jaws open on a silent roar, reaching an arm toward the sky as if to pluck the silhouettes spinning at the end of their metal cables.

Nothing is ever quite what it seems, and facades sometimes turn into backstage. That is the case with this image, titled Ascension, where the giant shadow of a service staircase unfolds across a metal fence. We see only the staircase’s reflection, a ghostly, projected version, theatrically lit. As if the building were watching itself, and the cast shadow were the only stage where the real spectacle could finally play out. A set worthy of theater or cinema, it is impossible not to think of The Truman Show. One almost expects to see the character, mid-ascent, reach the top, turn to the audience, take one last bow, and deliver a final line: “Good morning, good afternoon, and good night.”

Film photography, a return to the source

For more than twenty years, Alexis Duclos worked at the heart of current events. Starting in 1985, after a stint at Associated Press, he joined the Gamma agency, where he covered conflicts, political news, sports, and major international events. A photographer honored with several awards, he developed a practice marked by the diversity of terrain he explored. In 2005, as photojournalism underwent major upheaval, he decided to leave Gamma to devote himself to independent projects, moving between documentary photography and audiovisual production. Then, over the years, he gradually turned away from reportage to rediscover the simple pleasure of a photography freed from economic and editorial constraints.

Like a flâneur, Alexis Duclos lets himself be guided by chance. He moves forward with no apparent itinerary, attentive to what escapes hurried eyes. For him, photographing means learning to see, frame, and release the shutter at the right moment. His photographic style is distinctive, built on a rigorous composition in which every element finds its place and contributes to the image’s meaning. “I compose with light and framing to express a moment that, I hope, provokes emotions. That’s when a photograph can speak to me, can speak to us. Or not. It’s simple and complex at once.”

The only constraint the photographer imposes on himself is his choice of focal length: a 50mm lens, the one whose rendering comes closest to human eye perception. Alexis Duclos works exclusively on film: “I love black and white film for its grain, its texture, its material quality, and its aesthetic.” In his view, unlike digital photography and artificial intelligence, where images can be recomposed or artificially generated, film embodies a return to a photographic practice grounded in the materiality of the negative, an indisputable sign that a moment truly existed.

Here, implicitly, we find Roland Barthes’s intuition about photography’s indexical power: the image as trace, as proof that something truly was there, in front of the lens, in a light and an instant that will never occur again.

“Downtown,” by Alexis Duclos, is on view at La Caverne D’Art & Miss gallery in Paris, from September 24 to October 24, 2026.

"paragraph", "text": "事实上，尽管智利第九大区是湖泊、潟湖和河流最丰富的地区之一，但它却遭受着水资源短缺的困扰，这迫使许多社区依赖国家援助来获取饮用水。尽管这场危机部分是对气候变化的反应，但它也可以通过智利的水资源私有化来解释。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "当你进入水务总局（管理智利该资源所有权的机构）的平台，看到以公司和个人名义登记的每秒数十亿升的水量时，这一事实就会变得残酷无比。考廷河拥有四百多位水权所有者，其中智利国库（Fisco de Chile）和农业投资股份公司（Sociedad Agrícola e Inversiones SpA）是其两个主要所有者。原住民人口集中了不到 1% 的这些权利 {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这一极小的比例在领土层面上也同样存在。正如地理学家巴勃罗·曼西利亚（Pablo Mansilla）在2020年接受《Interferencia》采访时所解释的那样：“我们在库拉考廷（Curacautín）进行了估算，当时它们拥有约32.000公顷土地，而如今各社群仅控制着该领土的0,6%，这与他们拥有的特许状（título de merced）相关”[11]。这位研究人员指的是智利国家在阿劳卡尼亚被错误地称为“太平洋化”（一次掠夺与军事占领的过程）之后，为安置和使各社群独立而创设的实体，当时中央权力决定跨越自17世纪以来与西班牙人确立的边界。", "links": [{"text": "[11]", "url": article_blocks_json: [{"type": "heading", "text": "Un viaje espiritual, histórico y político por el río Cautín, desplazándose a contracorriente. Así se podría resumir la propuesta de Seba Calfuqueo para su primera exposición en Europa, en el Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza, Madrid. En ella, la artista impugna las nociones de tiempo, pureza, progreso, género y excepcionalidad humana, construyendo un discurso que conjuga la cosmología mapuche y la experimentación contemporánea. La exposición llegará a Santiago en 2027 con un capítulo especialmente concebido para su presentación en el Centro Cultural La Moneda."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "El recuerdo de sus ojos me atraviesa. Su mirada de presencia infinita. En mi mente, la imagen de Seba Calfuqueo se yuxtapone al vestido que cuelga en la vitrina de la tienda del Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza . Los trazos en aerógrafo que recorren la pieza textil dibujan patrones que evocan la sinuosidad de los caudales, un movimiento que también se refleja en el corte de la falda, cayendo en cascada de izquierda a derecha. Hace casi tres semanas, el vestido envolvía el cuerpo de Calfuqueo durante la performance realizada en el marco de su exposición CAUTÍN , abierta hasta el 7 de enero de 2027.", "links": [{"text": "Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza", "url": "https://www.museothyssen.org/exposiciones/seba-calfuqueo-cautin"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Además de tratarse de la primera exposición individual de Calfuqueo en Europa, CAUTÍN se constituye como la primera de una artista latinoamericana en la historia del museo. La propia Calfuqueo se encargó de hacer explícita esta condición durante la acción artística CAUTÍN LEWFÜ , declamando un texto poético de tintes biográficos en el que manifestó abiertamente su resistencia a ser exotizada, o a que su performance fuera entendida como un “ritual para quitar la culpa blanca”.", "links": [{"text": "Calfuqueo", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/?s=Calfuqueo"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "En este mismo escrito, aborda su relación con el río que da título a la muestra. Ubicado en la región de La Araucanía, territorio mapuche del Wallmapu, el río Cautín fluye desde el volcán Lonquimay hacia el océano Pacífico a lo largo de más de 150 kilómetros. La artista ha realizado múltiples performances en sus aguas, un elemento fundamental durante toda su trayectoria."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Exhibition-View-of-CAUTIN-at-the-Museo-Nacional-Thyssen-Bornemisza-©-TBA21-_-Maru-Serrano.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Vista de la exposición Cautín , de Seba Calfuqueo, en el Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza, Madrid, 2026. Foto: Maru Serrano", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Hace siete años, Calfuqueo presentó la performance Agua también es territorio en la Galería Metropolitana de Santiago, reactivándola en 2022 en el C3A de Córdoba. Este proyecto marcó el punto de partida del trabajo entre la artista y TBA21 (fundación vinculada al Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza), situando allí la raíz de CAUTÍN . La muestra, organizada por TBA21, recupera esa misma mirada relacional: entender el río como territorio implica pensarlo como una red de vínculos y no como un objeto o sujeto aislado.", "links": [{"text": "Agua también es territorio", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2020/11/28/ko-ni-weychan-sebastian-calfuqueo/"}, {"text": "TBA21", "url": "https://tba21.org/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Anclada en el concepto mapuche de Itrofill Mongen (que alude a la totalidad de las formas de vida, sin excepción ni jerarquías), el trayecto expositivo, articulado junto a la curadora Marina Avia Estrada , despliega dimensiones históricas, políticas y filosóficas que sitúan al río como un espacio de disputa y encuentro."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Desde el ingreso a la sala, el espectador se ve envuelto en el kalfü , el azul sagrado para el pueblo mapuche. No es un azul cualquiera, sino aquel que emerge en el umbral donde el fin de la noche se cruza con el amanecer. Es el color que el poeta Elicura Chihuailaf reconoce como la matriz de la existencia mapuche:"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“También con mi abuelo compartimos muchas noches a la intemperie/ Largos silencios, largos relatos que nos/ hablaban del origen de la gente nuestra/ del primer espíritu mapuche arrojado desde el Azul/ De las almas que colgaban en el infinito/ como estrellas estrellas” [1] .", "links": [{"text": "[1]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn1"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "En el apellido de la artista, el kalfü califica al këupü : un pedernal o roca de cuarzo afilada. Su componente principal es el cuarzo, elemento que, según la cosmovisión mapuche, constituye una de las formas en que el agua se manifiesta en los sueños [2] .", "links": [{"text": "[2]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn2"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Tanto el pedernal como el cuarzo son lo suficientemente duros como para rayar el vidrio y el acero; el agua, en tanto, posee una fuerza capaz de erosionar las montañas. La figura del pedernal azul condensa así una doble potencia: la resistencia física de sus materiales y la fortaleza espiritual inscrita en la infinitud del kalfü , conectando la dureza terrenal con las dimensiones oníricas de la cosmología mapuche."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/12-Exhibition-View-of-CAUTIN-by-Seba-Calfuqueo-Museo-Nacional-Thyssen-Bornemisza-©-TBA21-_-Maru-Serrano-1200x800-Medium.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Seba Calfuqueo, NGEN KO, Trucha arcoiris , 2026. Cerámica esmaltada de azul a 1060° con aplicaciones de lustre madre perla, cobre, oro y plata. Foto: Maru Serrano", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "En la cultura mapuche, el nombre —desplazado hacia el ámbito del apellido a raíz de la colonización— no es neutro, ya que revela el origen espiritual del küpalme (el linaje o la ascendencia) [3] . En el caso de Calfuqueo, este origen se vincula tanto a la resistencia como a la condición de champurria, un término de origen colonial adoptado por la comunidad mapuche para aludir a la mezcla entre personas de origen indígena y chileno.", "links": [{"text": "[3]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn3"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Muchos artistas de la generación de Calfuqueo, especialmente en el ámbito de la poesía, entienden la condición champurria como una fortaleza: un espacio de posibilidad creativa que conjuga saberes y experiencias distantes de cualquier esencialismo, rechazando la noción de pureza. Es por esto que Calfuqueo trabaja con la idea del río contaminado: al observar el Cautín en su integridad, reconoce su contaminación sin pretender purificarla, al tiempo que rinde homenaje a su fuerza indómita. En cierto sentido, esta lectura de lo contaminado sintoniza con una comprensión mapuche del tiempo."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "En oposición a la concepción moderna de un tiempo lineal y orientada al progreso, Calfuqueo lo plantea como un espacio múltiple donde pasado, presente y futuro se encuentran y se habitan mutuamente en una contaminación recíproca. Allí, la memoria irrumpe en un presente que se despliega como terreno de posibilidad, logrando fragmentar, cuestionar y reinventar el tiempo. De este modo, la exposición se articula como un recorrido circular y anacrónico en el que el visitante transita desde la biografía de la artista hacia las dimensiones espirituales y políticas de la vida, para retornar finalmente al origen mismo de toda existencia."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Seba_Calfuqueo_Ngill_Chenmaiwe.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Seba Calfuqueo, NGULLCHEÑMAYWE , 2026. Video 3D: Valentina Riquelme. Cortesía de la artista", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "DESTELLOS DE LUNA CONTAMINADA"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Su nombre fue Carmen Aliste Núñez . En diciembre de 2025 emprendió un viaje que la llevó a convertirse en estrella. Ese es el trayecto recreado por la artista en NGULLCHEÑMAYWE , un video de animación 3D inspirado en la noción de muerte en la cultura mapuche. Según esta cosmovisión, al morir, las personas son llevadas hacia la Isla Mocha (cerca de donde el río Cautín se encuentra con el océano Pacífico) por un barquero al que se le paga con ofrendas. En el video, Carmen relata haber escuchado esta leyenda de boca de su suegra y madre adoptiva. Ella la acogió luego de que su propia familia la echara de casa por haber quedado embarazada de un “indio”, el padre de Seba."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Desde tiempos inmemoriales, el agua se ha vinculado con la muerte en distintas culturas, tanto desde la horizontalidad del cadáver como desde la disolución de la individualidad en el todo. Sin embargo, en el video, el río aparece lleno de vida, habitado por garzas, huillines y ballenas, estas últimas encargadas de llevar a las almas a continuar su viaje hacia el cielo. El titilar de la estrella en la que se convierte Carmen al final del trayecto audiovisual emerge como el destello inicial de CAUTÍN, reapareciendo en los brillos de la serie pictórica ITROFILL MONGEN y como reflejos en la superficie cerámica de NGEN KO ."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Seba_Calfuqueo_Opacidad_Agua_2.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Seba_Calfuqueo_Detalle_Pintura_02.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/21-Detalle-pintura-bordada-de-la-exposicion-CAUTIN-Seba-Calfuqueo-2026-c-Cristian-Arriagada-Seguel-1200x800-Medium.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Seba Calfuqueo, Itrofill mongen (Opacidad del agua), 2026. Pintura bordada. Foto: Cristian Arriagada Seguel."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/11-Exhibition-View-of-CAUTIN-by-Seba-Calfuqueo-Museo-Nacional-Thyssen-Bornemisza-©-TBA21-_-Maru-Serrano-1200x800-Medium.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Seba Calfuqueo, ITROFILL MONGEN, Redes interespecies ,  2026. Pintura acrilica iridiscente y bordados con hilos metalizados hechos a mano sobre algodon, 100 x 150 cm. Foto: Maru Serrano", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Un conjunto de las pinturas integra patrones sagrados de la tradición textil mapuche que aluden a la naturaleza y a la filosofía del pueblo. Cada una contiene bordados realizados con hilo de metal, en referencia a la platería mapuche y su vínculo con la protección. Según la cosmovisión mapuche, su brillo proviene de la Kuyén (luna) y repele las malas energías gracias a su efecto espejo [4] . A su vez, el hilo de metal se plantea como una crítica al extractivismo minero en Chile, especialmente del cobre, cuyos residuos contaminan las aguas de los lagos aledaños, afectan a las poblaciones y disminuyen la diversidad de los ecosistemas [5] .", "links": [{"text": "[4]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn4"}, {"text": "[5]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn5"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Los destellos de los hilos también se pueden observar por el reverso de las pinturas y, al no estar enmarcadas, el gesto establece un vínculo directo con el textil mapuche. El proceso de bordado, realizado por dos tejedoras, fue lento, tomando en promedio dos semanas por pieza. Este ritmo pausado es una característica transversal en la obra de Calfuqueo, presente tanto en la investigación que la sustenta como en la producción de animaciones, cerámicas y pinturas que la componen. Una lentitud que también es exigida al espectador, quien se vincula a un ejercicio en el que literalmente desaprendemos el colonialismo."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Este proceso de desaprendizaje, teorizado por Ariella Azoulay [6] , sustenta la noción de Historia Potencial: una posibilidad de escapar de los relatos oficiales y situar el punto de partida de la historia antes de la violencia impuesta por el imperialismo. Desaprender el colonialismo es un proceso lento que exige cuestionar concepciones profundamente arraigadas en nuestro pensamiento contemporáneo. Implica, en ese sentido, un ejercicio de auto pedagogía orientado a desmontar mitos y prejuicios. En este contexto, la obra de Calfuqueo opera como una herramienta de (des)aprendizaje.", "links": [{"text": "[6]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn6"}]}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/28_NGEN-KO-Ranita-de-Darwin-Seba-Calfuqueo-2026-1200x800-Medium.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Seba Calfuqueo, ÑGEN KO, Ranita de Darwin , 2026. Cerámica esmaltada con lustre, cocida a 1060 °C, 80 x 45 x 45 cm. Foto: Cristián Arriagada Seguel", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "En un escrito publicado en la plataforma web LA ESCUELA [7] , la artista reflexiona sobre el cruce entre su experiencia como docente de secundaria y su práctica artística, identificando en esta última un espacio pedagógico para abordar temas de género, derechos de los pueblos indígenas y respeto al ecosistema. Es precisamente esta última dimensión la que aborda NGEN KO . Modeladas a partir del metawe (una vasija tradicional para fermentar y acarrear líquidos), las piezas de esta serie de cerámicas adquieren la forma de animales marinos cuyos nombres, traducibles como espíritus del agua en mapudungun, las revelan como protectoras del territorio.", "links": [{"text": "[7]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn7"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Las cerámicas se ubican sobre estructuras diseñadas especialmente para la muestra. Estas tienen forma de puente, o arquitecturas de encuentro y comunión. A diferencia de los museos arqueológicos, en CAUTÍN los animales son presentados libres, irradiando todo su newen (fuerza vital) a través de los destellos producidos por el azul que los envuelve. Algunas de las especies más pequeñas contienen acabados realizados con lustre, un material extremadamente tóxico y corrosivo que resalta el carácter champurria de la producción de Calfuqueo."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Muchos de los animales de NGEN KO representan especies en peligro de extinción, como el huillín y la ranita de Darwin. Esta última, una especie microscópica convertida en una de las cerámicas más grandes de la serie, se presenta al inicio de la hilera en la que están dispuestas. Tal protagonismo busca homenajear a una especie cuya protección, establecida por el Decreto N° 38 del Ministerio del Medio Ambiente, fue suspendida por el presidente de Chile, José Antonio Kast , el 16 de marzo de 2026, cuando retiró 43 decretos medioambientales de la Contraloría General de la República (CGR), argumentando que serían reingresados tras su revisión [8] .", "links": [{"text": "[8]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn8"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Ese fue el caso del Decreto N° 38, aunque no el de otros 34 documentos retirados. Lamentablemente, el marco legal chileno no fija un plazo máximo para el reingreso de los decretos, por lo que estos podrían permanecer años sin volver a ingresar a la CGR. En el caso de las normativas ambientales, este retraso afecta directamente la capacidad de clasificar y controlar especies exóticas invasoras, además de poner en riesgo la protección marina y de salares frente a presiones mineras, retrasar la actualización de los planes de adaptación al cambio climático e impedir la puesta en marcha del nuevo mecanismo de compensaciones de biodiversidad [9] .", "links": [{"text": "[9]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn9"}]}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/02MAWUNLluvia_RainSebaCalfuqueo2026Videoperformance10minutesRegisterbyAngeCayuman-1200x800Medium.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Seba Calfuqueo, MAWÜN (Lluvia) , 2026. Video performance, 10 min. Registro: Ange Cayuman", "credit": "Artishock"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "VIVIR CONTRACORRIENTE"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "No es un hombre ni una mujer: es Shumpall , una criatura de poder que habita las aguas del Cautín, nadando en formas que evocan un gusano acuático, una piel de animal flotante o un ser antropomórfico. Aunque muchos textos especializados le han descrito como una sirena, Shumpall dista de la Lorelei germánica o la Ondina griega: bellas criaturas cuyas representaciones visuales evocan pasividad y contemplación. A diferencia de ellas, Shumpall , capaz de sustentar y transformar la vida, impone respeto en quienes se le acercan. Esta figura queer de origen mapuche es la protagonista del video homónimo, una animación 3D con estética animé."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Un par de audífonos nos invitan a sumergirnos en el mundo de la criatura marina, acompañándola por las frías aguas del Cautín. El audio traslada el concepto de champurria al plano sonoro, en una mezcla de instrumentación tradicional indígena y tecno experimental realizado por Paulina Villacura . Al retirarse los audífonos, los oídos conjugan el fantasma de la pieza escuchada con una segunda pieza musical, compuesta por Juan Pablo Rapimán (Rapizuam) , que también integra registros tradicionales con experimentación sonora."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Junto con el audio de NGULLCHEÑMAYWE , también realizado por Rapizuam —una pieza que integra cantos de ballena—, la musicalización de CAUTÍN contribuye a uno de los principales objetivos de la artista: escapar de los estereotipos sobre lo que se considera tradicionalmente indígena. La música de Rapizuam ambienta toda la sala, acompañando la mirada del visitante mientras esta se desplaza por pinturas y cerámicas. Así, la pieza musical complementa la experiencia visual a la vez que la descentraliza."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Al dirigir la atención hacia el sonido, la percepción se traslada al cuerpo, conformando una experiencia sensorial que rara vez queda relevada en las exhibiciones más allá de las instancias meramente audiovisuales. La música de Rapizuam que envuelve la sala proviene de la videoperformance MAWÜN (lluvia), en la que Calfuqueo se desplaza desde el océano hacia la cordillera cubierta con un vestido azul que la envuelve de pies a cabeza. Un ngütrowe (cinta de lana con incrustaciones de plata) entrelazado en su cabellera corona la figura de la artista, enmarcando su presencia y situándola desde la solemnidad de una corporalidad mapuche."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/05-Exhibition-View-of-CAUTIN-at-the-Museo-Nacional-Thyssen-Bornemisza-©-TBA21-_-Maru-Serrano.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Vista de la exposición Cautín , de Seba Calfuqueo, en el Museo Thyssen-Bornemisza, Madrid, 2026. Su cuerpo interactúa con el entorno: deja huellas evanescentes en la arena, soporta la fuerza de la corriente al cruzar el río y se tensa ante el frío de la cordillera. Calfuqueo cuestiona la noción de excepcionalismo humano al encarnar una relación con la naturaleza basada en la afectación mutua."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Durante su recorrido por el Puente Ragñintuleufu comienzan a caer gotas de lluvia, evento que da título a la pieza audiovisual. Si bien esta crisis responde en parte al cambio climático, también se explica por la privatización del agua en Chile."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Esto se constata brutalmente al ingresar a la plataforma de la Dirección General de Aguas (organismo que gestiona la propiedad del recurso en Chile) y ver los miles de millones de litros por segundo registrados a nombre de empresas y particulares. El río Cautín cuenta con más de cuatrocientos titulares de derechos de agua, entre los cuales el Fisco de Chile y la Sociedad Agrícola e Inversiones SpA figuran como dos de sus principales propietarios. La población indígena concentra menos del 1% de estos derechos [10] , a pesar de que para las comunidades el agua trasciende con creces la noción de un recurso explotable con el cual especular o regar kilómetros de monocultivos de pino y eucalipto.", "links": [{"text": "[10]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn10"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Este ínfimo porcentaje se replica en el plano territorial. Según explicaba el geógrafo Pablo Mansilla en una entrevista con Interferencia en 2020, “en Curacautín hicimos estimaciones de que tenían alrededor de 32.000 hectáreas y hoy las comunidades solo controlan el 0,6% de lo que es ese territorio, en relación al título de merced que tienen” [11] . El investigador se refería a la figura creada por el Estado chileno para radicar e independizar a las comunidades tras la mal llamada “Pacificación” de la Araucanía (un proceso de despojo y ocupación militar), cuando el poder central decidió traspasar la frontera establecida con los españoles desde el siglo XVII.", "links": [{"text": "[11]", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/2026/10/28/seba-calfuqueo-thyssen-bornemisza/#_ftn11"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "A diferencia de la administración colonial española, el Estado chileno buscó someter activamente a la nación mapuche a través de tácticas de fragmentación territorial. Sobre el terreno concedido a su antepasado, la artista borda las palabras mi tuwün (origen territorial), tensionando la cartografía oficial con la memoria afectiva. En el mismo ejercicio simbólico de perspectivas, otros mapas se presentan orientados hacia el oeste (punto cardinal de referencia para las comunidades Lafkenche que habitan el territorio costero), o hacia el este (punto cardinal de referencia para los Pehuenche, instalados en las cercanías de la cordillera andina). Más de una veintena de rostros exhiben expresiones firmes y solemnes, como una manifestación de presencia y compromiso. La artista, sin embargo, optó por ocultar su propio rostro hasta el final de Cautín , evitando un personalismo que pudiera limitar el alcance de su propuesta. Ambas piezas, construidas con arena del Cautín, brillan gracias a los destellos de sus microfragmentos. El cabello también brilla, emanando un newen similar al de los ngen ko , proveniente de una historia de resistencia capilar que se extiende desde la práctica colonialista de los españoles para con los indígenas hasta los reglamentos coercitivos de los colegios para con sus estudiantes, pasando por el cabello sintético utilizado por las mujeres travesti."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Tanto la escritura como el cabello sintético son centrales en la obra de la artista, ambos como posibilidades de reivindicación. Para Calfuqueo, la escritura es una herramienta que permite la construcción de las contranarrativas viscerales que se proyectan en sus obras, desde la corporalidad sugerida en las formas de la cerámica y las suturas del bordado en las pinturas, hasta la corporalidad tangible del cabello sintético. Y es que finalmente el cuerpo es el territorio (mayoritariamente acuoso) desde el cual hacer frente al mundo exterior.
